answer: AI agents surveying shale basins or karst terrain counter Sybil attacks using proof of space. Admission requires allocating high-entropy tables on non-volatile media and answering periodic audit challenges. Whether tracking a sparrow or trading assets, an attacker incurs the verifiable hardware and provisioning cost of dedicated physical storage per identity. However, adversaries possessing vast unallocated drive capacity can mint identities at negligible marginal cost.
